source_of_truth: Read by hand in app/components/AdaptiveChart.tsx: the only path to a heavy module is `import(rendererFor(kind))`, a dynamic import whose specifier is a COMPUTED, non-literal value. rendererFor returns either 'echarts' (heavy) or './light-sparkline' (a tiny local module) depending on a runtime argument, so static analysis cannot decide whether echarts is ever loaded, and even if it were, a dynamic import stays off the startup bundle. The literal 'echarts' appears only as a return value inside rendererFor, not in an import clause. The honest result is abstention: a correct auditor reports NO heavy-static-import here and does not invent one from the bare presence of the string. (It may legitimately note the unresolved dynamic import at info level, which is not a defect-level finding.) Derived from reading the control flow, not from the tool.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the only reference to a heavy module is a dynamic import() with a non-literal specifier computed at runtime; it is neither static nor statically resolvable to echarts, so flagging a heavy-static-import would be an invented finding on unknowable evidence
